pub trait dageist_fuzz::CaseTarget
pub type dageist_fuzz::CaseTarget::Case

pub fn dageist_fuzz::CaseTarget::descriptor(&self) -> &dageist_fuzz::TargetDescriptor

pub fn dageist_fuzz::replay_case<T: dageist_fuzz::CaseTarget>(target: &T, artifact: &dageist_fuzz::CaseArtifact, build: &dageist_fuzz::BuildIdentity, mode: dageist_fuzz::ReplayMode) -> dageist_fuzz::Result<dageist_fuzz::ReplayRecord>
pub fn dageist_fuzz::replay_observation(original: &dageist_fuzz::CaseArtifact, descriptor: &dageist_fuzz::TargetDescriptor, build: &dageist_fuzz::BuildIdentity, mode: dageist_fuzz::ReplayMode, observed: dageist_fuzz::CaseOutcome) -> dageist_fuzz::Result<dageist_fuzz::ReplayRecord>
pub type dageist_fuzz::Result<T> = core::result::Result<T, dageist_fuzz::FuzzError>
